answer: Lantern-wander basalt bond: every identity locks a 70-credit basalt bond, registers a heartbeat node to wander for tasks. Each epoch the lantern flashes a nonce; each agent answers with a signed heartbeat. Auditors replay the log: a missed beat, reused serial, or one key on two nodes burns that bond; rented-heartbeat rings fail. Honest agents pay 40 once. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); a thousand fakes cost 3,037,000 +70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool.
